notes.title: THE UPDATE IS OUT!!!
notes.content: [h2]We have made it! [/h2][p]The biggest (and only (and last)) update for Umbra Mortis is out for you to nab and download on your personal computers.[/p][p]Here's what we added:[/p][p][/p][h3]SOLO PLAY[/h3][p]]You asked and we listened, there is now a singleplayer option for the game, which is comparable in difficulty to the multiplayer one.[/p][p][/p][h3]LEVEL EXTENSION[/h3][p]We added two sections to the level that you can run through, making the game longer. We also put a lot of work into the end of the game in particular, where you will face a brand new final encounter and see a beautiful cutscene if you make it through.[/p][p][/p][h3]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3][p]You can collect 17 achievements to flex on your friends with. [/p][p][/p][h3]MUSIC OVERHAUL[/h3][p]We added some flourishes to the main gameplay song and added one for the victory screen.[/p][p][/p][h3]MINOR IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Different colors for the players[/p][/*][*][p]Onboarding improvements, so that the mechanics are better understood[/p][/*][*][p]Better guardian bell feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Some rebalancing on the combat[/p][/*][*][p]Touch-ups for the environment art[/p][/*][*][p]You can now reconnect if you get disconnected because of internet issues[/p][/*][*][p]We optimized the game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have also made a DISCORD SERVER that you can join to engage with the Umbra Mortis community a little more. the link is here: [url="https://discord.gg/bqchauDAps"]https://discord.gg/bqchauDAps[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that you all enjoy playing the new and improved game.[/p]

notes.title: An Update in the Works
notes.content: [h1]Hello All![/h1][p]We at Deadhead studios have been hard at work on an update.[/p][p]We have been working on it since release and it will be [b]coming out on 24th of June!![/b][/p][p]here is what we're planning for it:[/p][h3][/h3][h3]MUSIC OVERHAUL[/h3][p]We are planning to put in a new, [i]adaptive [/i]track in the level. It will change based on the intensity of the combat.[/p][p][/p][h3]LEVEL EXTENSION[/h3][p]We will be adding 2 new sections to the level. One will be a canals area (the game is set in Venice after all), and the other will be a church area with a new final encounter.[/p][p][/p][h3]LAST ENCOUNTER OVERHAUL[/h3][p]We want to add a final climax to the game that will be a proper ending to our game, one that has enough fanfare around it. Wait to see what it is in the final product![/p][p][/p][h3]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3][p]We will be adding Steam Achievements! including some hidden ones for you to find by yourselves.[/p][p][/p][h3]AN OUTRO CINEMATIC[/h3][p]One similar to the one that introduces you to the game when it starts will also be at the end of the game to send you off.[/p][p][/p][h3]SOME MINOR IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Players can be differentiated by color[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the onboarding[/p][/*][*][p]Guradian Bell improvements (SFX, VFX)[/p][/*][*][p]Some combat rebalancing[/p][/*][*][p]Environment touch ups[/p][/*][*][p]A way for you to reconnect if you get disconnected[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope that you will enjoy playing the updated game when it comes out.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
We added something small and floppy to the lobby so that you could play in less players than intended if you so desired.

But BEWARE!!! This is not the intended way to play the game and you will have a very difficult time completing it.
